verdict: DIRECTNESS IS A REAL ADMISSION CRITERION. Only 31.6% of causal edges are bound at the promoter -- most transcriptional consequences of knocking down a TF are downstream, not direct -- though binding is 1.27x enriched at causal targets (p 8.26e-143) against a 25.0% background, which is itself high: the median promoter here carries peaks from ~96 of 392 TFs. Matched on effect size and promoter busyness over 20 draws, DIRECT edges transfer to RPE1 better on BOTH halves of the signed prediction: magnitude 1.629 vs 1.384 (100% of draws p<0.05) and sign 69.5% vs 65.6% (100% of draws p<0.05).
